lead: A valgrind stack whose allocation site is `NvsArray::make_unique` under `nvs_array_set` names an array *literal*, not the array write path.
body: The empty array is a per-thread singleton, so `nvs_codegen`'s `emit_array_new` chain always separates on its first `nvs_array_set`, which makes `make_unique` the allocation site of every non-empty literal in the program. Read such a report as "an array literal was never released", not as a dropped copy-on-write clone.
